reviews.text: This place is a lifesaver! The play area kept my 3-year-old entertained while we enjoyed a peaceful meal. The staff brought crayons and coloring books without us even asking.
reviews.highlight: The outdoor patio has misters for hot days and the kids menu is actually healthy - not just chicken nuggets!

reviews.text: Best brunch spot for families, hands down. The garden area is amazing - my kids played in the sandbox while we relaxed. Kids eat free on Sundays is a huge bonus!
reviews.highlight: They have a diaper changing station in both restrooms and the staff is incredibly patient.

reviews.text: We celebrated our daughter's 8th birthday here and it was perfect. The staff sang happy birthday, brought out a special dessert, and the kids loved the festive atmosphere.
reviews.highlight: Great for families who don't mind a little noise - the lively atmosphere means your kids won't be the loudest ones there!

reviews.text: My boys (ages 6 and 9) absolutely LOVED watching the pizza being tossed! The arcade in the back kept them busy while we waited. Perfect casual family dinner spot.
reviews.highlight: Ask for the large booth in the back - it's right next to the arcade and has room for a high chair.

reviews.text: The indoor treehouse is absolutely magical! My 2 and 4 year olds didn't want to leave. The organic kids menu made me feel good about what they were eating.
reviews.highlight: They host story time on Tuesday mornings - combine it with lunch for a full morning activity!

reviews.text: Finally, a place where I can actually drink my coffee while it's still hot! The supervised play area is genius. Kids burn off energy, parents get a break. Win-win!
reviews.highlight: Book ahead for weekends - it gets packed. Weekday mornings are much calmer.

reviews.text: The pancake art is incredible! My daughter was thrilled with her unicorn pancake. Even my picky eater found something he loved. We'll definitely be back.
reviews.highlight: Get there early on weekends - the wait can be 30+ minutes after 9am.

reviews.text: Great BBQ and the bouncy house on Saturdays is a hit! Only downside is it can get really loud when there's live music. Bring earplugs for sensitive kids.
reviews.highlight: The kids brisket plate is huge - we split one between our two kids and still had leftovers.

reviews.text: The conveyor belt sushi is so much fun for kids! They loved picking their own plates. The private tatami room was perfect for our large family group.
reviews.highlight: Book the tatami room in advance - it fits up to 12 and kids can move around freely.

reviews.text: Classic burgers and shakes - exactly what kids want! The mini sliders are perfect for smaller appetites. The jukebox at the table is a nice touch.
reviews.highlight: Don't skip the Oreo milkshake - it's huge and the kids can share.

reviews.text: Feels like eating at grandma's house! The mac and cheese is the best my kids have ever had. They give out fresh cookies at the end - such a sweet touch.
reviews.highlight: The chicken pot pie is big enough to share with a kid. Save room for the cookie!

reviews.text: Upscale Italian that still welcomes kids - rare find! My daughter loved watching pasta being made. A bit quieter atmosphere so better for older kids.
reviews.highlight: Go early (5pm) for a calmer dining experience with kids. The kids' spaghetti portion is generous.

reviews.text: Perfect for picky eaters! My son could choose exactly what went in his bowl. The staff was patient explaining all the options. Clean and modern space.
reviews.highlight: Start with a small bowl - the portions are bigger than they look!

reviews.text: Build-your-own waffles are so fun! Kids can go wild with toppings. They have gluten-free waffles which is great for my daughter with celiac. Will be our new weekend tradition!
reviews.highlight: The chocolate chip waffle with strawberries is the most popular with kids.

reviews.text: Classic fish and chips with a view! Kids were mesmerized by the sea lions. A bit touristy but genuinely good food. The play corner keeps little ones busy.
reviews.highlight: Sit on the patio if weather permits - best views of the sea lions!
